message: サリーちゃんの逆襲

name: Synn
message: 「W-We somehow beat them」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now then, since you've quieted down, let's hear your story」

name: Sally
message: 「No way, pffft」

name: Nanaka
message: 「This kid is seriously not cute at all! No dinner for you tomorrow!」

name: Sally
message: 「Aaahn, just kidding, just kidding. I'm sorryyy\s06」

name: Boss / Oyabin
message: 「Me, tasty food, want to eat」

name: Misa
message: 「You're still thinking with your stomach?」

name: Sally
message: 「That's not it. We are the ones who keep wandering in search of the delicious foods rampant in the Human World, going by the name--」

name: Sally
message: 「'The Delicious Food Squad~♪'」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, that thing~」

name: Synn
message: 「And their Boss is this...」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Eauderourke」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah」

name: Sally
message: 「We heard there's lots of yummy stuff in the Human World, so we came all this way, and yet...」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Food, can't eat. Right away, get mad. Me, sad」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If you dine and dash, that's just what you deserve!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Let us off the hook with this for today~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Omake-san! Isn't that your super-precious good-sleep pillow, 'Neru-Neru-Nerune'?!」
Sally-chan's trump card... huh.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, hold onto that for now. I'll try explaining the situation to the manager」

name: Sally
message: 「Uuuh, I love you, Prez~\s06」
In exchange for smoothing things over, we were told that dealing with the demons would be left up to the Student Council.

name: Synn
message: 「That said, it's already late today...」

name: Misa
message: 「Once we get back, we have a mountain of things we need to do」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ugh... Come to think of it, that's true.」

name: Sally
message: 「Sorry, everyone. I don't really get it, though.」

name: Ria
message: 「Come to school next week. Let's think about what to do from here together.」

name: Sally
message: 「Awoo, you're so nice. Guess having huge boobs really does make a difference.」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-That has nothing to do with it!\s03」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Understood.」
Saying that, Eauderourke vanished into the dark night, a melancholic air hanging over his back.

name: Synn
message: 「Wonder if we were a little too harsh on him...」

name: Misa
message: 「Coddlings like that are exactly why villains get cocky.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, by the way, check this out. Got it as a souvenir. Said it's thanks for today.」

name: Synn
message: 「Th... This is...!?」
Thanks to this, tonight's dinner is bound to put everyone in a very happy mood.

name: Synn
message: 「We're home~♪」

name: Sally
message: 「Welcome back~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, that was fast! Didn't you go back with Boss?」

name: Sally
message: 「It's way more comfortable here than at the hideout~ More importantly, food, food!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hehehe, tonight's dinner is none other than--」

name: Ria
message: 「Fast, cheap, and delicious beef bowl bentos~\s04」

name: Sally
message: 「Oooooooooooh!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Unfortunately, however, there isn't a portion for a tagalong like you.」

name: Sally
message: 「Eeeeeeeeeeeh?!」

name: Misa
message: 「After causing that much trouble, it's only natural.」

name: Sally
message: 「Tch. Should I have sided with the Student Council back there instead of Boss?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「After eating all that earlier, you're telling me you're still not full?」

name: Sally
message: 「Boss was the one who ate it! I didn't get to eat anything at all!」

name: Paqy
message: 「There ain't even enough for yours truly. Suck it up and eat curry, flat-chest」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm not flat! And anyway, don't eat food when you're just a stuffed animal!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'll give you an extra-large serving of curry today. Right, Synn?」

name: Sally
message: 「Give me beef bowl. Give me beef bowl. Give me beef bowl」

name: Synn
message: 「Sigh... Can't be helped, I guess. Here, take this」
I held out my own beef bowl to Sally-chan.

name: Synn
message: 「Let's split it in half--」

name: Sally
message: 「Nom nom, chomp chomp. Yum, yum, so good! Beef is so good, meat is yummy!」

name: Sally
message: 「Lick. Thanks for the meal!」

name: Sally
message: 「I love you, Prez\s04 Super LOVE\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Heyyyyyy\s06」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you guys even doing? C'mon, bring a bowl over. I'll share some with you」

name: Ria
message: 「Here, have some of mine too」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Every day is a day for sharing, indeed」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm only jumping on the bandwagon because everyone else said they'd share!」
Before I knew it, this strangely familiar sight blurred behind my tears.

name: Synn
message: 「Sniff... Thanks, everyone」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, how's it taste?」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Ria
message: 「Truly. This might actually be the first time I've ever eaten a beef bowl」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We usually only eat thick cuts of beef that are too tough to chew through, after all~」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-Yeah, that's right~. Nom nom」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We've got enemies of the common people here. Say something to 'em, Synn!」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」
After filling our half-full stomachs with our signature curry, everyone got to work.

name: Nanaka
message: 「All done! Need a hand with anything?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whew~. Yes, please~」
One by one, as each person finished their task and pitched in to help the others, the end suddenly came into sight.

name: Ria
message: 「I think that just about wraps everything up.」

name: Everyone
message: 「Good work today.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wheeeew.」
Then, everyone flopped down onto their backs on the floor all at once.

name: Nanaka
message: 「That flew by, but--what time is it now?」

name: Synn
message: 「Just before ten.」

name: Misa
message: 「We finished earlier than I expected.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's almost time for a bath~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right. I'll go get it ready.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hold it! Are you seriously going to let these ladies use *that* bath?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Thanks for being so considerate. Really, though, it's totally fine.」

name: Misa
message: 「Exactly. A cramped tub is no big deal at all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We're way past that level of problem here!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oooh~~!」

name: Synn
message: 「Now I just light the gas burner and... it turns into a shower, see?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amazing. I've never seen a bath like this before!」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「What is it, what is it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh boy...」
Everyone crowded over to take a look at the bath.

name: Ria
message: 「The washing area *is* the bath...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. A collaboration between a sink area and a bath. What you'd call a unit bath」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like hell it is!」

name: Synn
message: 「Now then, go ahead in order」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oka~y♪　Then I'll take the first bath~♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Lolo-chan, stop!」

name: Misa
message: 「There's no way we can use something like this!!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Something like this……?」

name: Misa
message: 「There isn't even a partition in the first place!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You'd go in if there were a partition?」

name: Ria
message: 「Well…… at least, if we had that…… right\s02」

name: Paqy
message: 「A partition, a partition!　Hey, let's get one ready fast!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No helping it. Let's all go to a public bathhouse or something」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How disappointing~~」
Taking a quick bath left me feeling clean and refreshed. The mixed scents of various shampoos make my heart race.

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well then. Maybe I should go bring the futons over soon……」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Getting ready for bed already!?　What a waste~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You little delinquent. Still, I like your spirit!」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, let's carry them together」

name: Misa
message: 「Ehh!?　Then me too!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I won't allow anyone to get a head start♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait up--」
My precious excuse to slip away had spiraled into something outrageous.

name: Synn
message: 「Um, it's warmer in here, so bring everyone's four futons over. I'll move mine to the next room」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What are you saying, Mr. President!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Of course we're all going to stay up late and hang out together!」

name: Misa
message: 「Even so, boys and girls sleeping in the same room is a problem.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's basically just like a school trip, right, Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Eh, ah. Yeah. Right, right. Something like that is totally normal, isn't it? Probably.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Or could it be you're such an innocent little maiden that just having a guy nearby makes you boil over~? Oh, Misa, you're so cuuute.」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-th-there's no way that's true!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then it's settled. C'mon, get moving, get moving!」
I'm the one about to reach my boiling point here!
Futons are laid out wall-to-wall in the cramped room, and everyone sits down on top of them.

name: Misa
message: 「Aren't you all going to change?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not yet. The night has only just begun--just be-gun! If we change now, we'll just get sleepy!」

name: Ria
message: 「You're super hyped up, Nanaka-chan~♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're one to talk, Senpai-san--the ends of your sentences are practically dancing~♪」

name: Paqy
message: 「Zzz, zzz」
Even if the Great Sage is a Plushie, I suppose he really is showing his age.

name: Nanaka
message: 「When it comes to late-night games, there's only one choice! And its name is Old Hag!」

name: Misa
message: 「It's Old Maid. Honestly, what a typical game for you to pick, Nanaka-san.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She's looking down on it as just a card game, boss. This battle that was once even called a witch hunt!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Heh heh heh. Now then, I'm looking forward to seeing what era you can keep up until.」

name: Misa
message: 「I will defy fate, and I will definitely win!」

name: Ria
message: 「I never knew Old Maid was on such a grand scale~」

name: Sally
message: 「Whatcha doooing! Let me join in tooo!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's past bedtime for kids~」

name: Sally
message: 「This is where I get serious. Sanctuary--what you'd call 'the zone,' I'm telling ya!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Nodding off... how lovely the spring weather is~」

name: Sally
message: 「Look. The angel's already asleep.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Gah, brrr! Close call, close call, a real Pop-Up Pirate moment!」

name: Synn
message: 「You can go to sleep if you want. Don't push yourself.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No, no. It's a rare sleepover, so I'm hanging in there till morning tonight! Yeah!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah!」

name: Misa
message: 「You're still holding up okay, right, Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh?! Oh, yeah! Of course, I'm totally fine!」

name: Misa
message: 「Impressive.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem. I may not look it, but I'm a big sister, you know. I'm gonna make sure to snap Instax pics of everyone's sleeping faces~」
Even though she said all that.

name: Ria
message: 「Zzz... zzz...」

name: Synn
message: 「To think Senpai would be the first one down...」

name: Misa
message: 「Big Sister's sleeping face is so lovely\s04」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Treasurer... With this. With this one card, I'll settle this match!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I can't afford to rot away in a place like this...!」

name: Misa
message: 「Come on. If you don't hurry, she's going to fall asleep.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shaddup!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, coming! Come on-a my house!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Guh.」
A pair of cards flutters down from Lolotte's hand.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gah!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz... zzz...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, this is a win by default, isn't it?」

name: Sally
message: 「Pfft. Nanaka, you suck.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grr, so frustrating! At this rate, we're going all out until I win!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha, you're just like Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't lump me in with her!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Prepare yourself, Sally-chan!」

name: Sally
message: 「This card is my trademark, after all. Gotta take good care of it~\s07」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grrrrr... This time, I won't fall for that trick」

name: Sally
message: 「Consolation prize!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gah--I got tricked agaaaain」

name: Synn
message: 「Being too honest is a sin sometimes, huh」

name: Sally
message: 「Now it's a one-on-one with Prez. Come on, who's gonna be the loser, kushishi」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa's getting tired of waiting, so we'd better wrap this up quick」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If you were weaker, you'd get to play against Synn forever, you know」

name: Misa
message: 「Zzz, zzz... izza match not over yet...」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh boy」

name: Synn
message: 「After being made to wait that long... well, yeah」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aah, don't take that one! Eek, I lost again! One more round!」

name: Sally
message: 「Why don't you just give it up already? Your eyes are totally bloodshot」

name: Nanaka
message: 「These are tears of blood shed in frustration!」

name: Synn
message: 「Got it, got it, I'm hitting the restroom for a sec」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't you dare win and run--」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not, I'm not」

name: Sally
message: 「She's talking in her sleep, talking in her sleep. She lay down for a quick break and went straight to snoring」

name: Synn
message: 「Sally-chan. You look totally fine」

name: Sally
message: 「Well, I'm totally nocturnal, after all」
My butt feels like it's about to glow like a firefly.

name: Synn
message: 「None of them are really night owls, I guess. Getting all rowdy when they're already exhausted」

name: Sally
message: 「You're the one who's still super energetic, Prez」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I used to pull all-nighters to cram pretty often」

name: Sally
message: 「What's that, is it tasty?」

name: Synn
message: 「Anyway, I think I'll head to sleep soon too」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, nighty-night~」
Yeah, there's no way I can actually sleep right in the middle of them…….
Thinking that, I tried to lift myself up, when--

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nooo…… don't gooo……」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey, Nanaka?」

name: Misa
message: 「Packyyy……」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, n-n-n-not there……!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm gonna eat you up~」

name: Synn
message: 「No way」

name: Ria
message: 「Demon Lord……\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh……」
While I was flinching like that, they ended up pinning my arms behind me.

name: Synn
message: 「It's super heavy and I can't move, though it's kinda soft and warm……\s03」
――Wait, no, bad Student Council President! One guy surrounded by a bunch of girls is totally no good!

name: Paqy
message: 「Yours truly is right here~~」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oh yeah, right--」
Actually, though, maybe this is one of the perks of being Student Council President.

name: Synn
message: 「Haa, haa……」
At this rate, I'm gonna get too worked up to sleep…….

name: Misa
message: 「Nnh…… mmmh」
A soft lump of flesh presses right up against my thigh.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Stop iiit, I said that tickles……」
A-A soft sensation against my palm.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Not there, you can't...」
Plump, shapely legs clamping down around my arm.

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez, you're such a spoiled baby~\s05」

name: Synn
message: 「Habu!」
Nununununu, I'm on the verge of suffocating.

name: Synn
message: 「----Pwah! Sally-chan!」

name: Sally
message: 「What is it」

name: Synn
message: 「Let me sleep over there!」

name: Sally
message: 「Eh, eeeh!! Pervert! Sneaking into a maiden's bed this late at night is way too perverted! That's night crawling, N-I-G-H-T C-R-A-W-L-I-N-G」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't worry, something like that wouldn't happen even if heaven and earth turned upside down」

name: Sally
message: 「How rude! Hmph\s09」

name: Synn
message: 「Haguh!!」
W-Why a washtub……?
